<div class="canvas">

<div class="header-row">
<div class="header-title">
<div class="title-main">wt End-to-End Idea-to-Software Workflow</div>
<div class="title-sub">Turning a stray thought into finished, working software — and learning from the results.</div>
</div>
<div class="loop-callout">
<div class="loop-callout-title"><svg class="icon"><use href="#i-refresh"></use></svg>A Loop, Not a Line</div>
<div class="loop-callout-sub">What we learn at the end informs what we do next.</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="stage-row">

<div class="stage-col" data-node="capture">
<div class="stage-head"><span class="stage-num capture">1</span><span class="stage-name capture">Capture</span></div>
<div class="stage-card capture">
<div class="stage-icon"><svg class="icon"><use href="#i-bulb"></use></svg></div>
<div class="stage-desc">Jot the idea down the moment it occurs.</div>
<hr/>
<div class="stage-how">How:</div>
<ul>
<li><code>wt idea</code></li>
<li><code>wt-capture</code> skill</li>
<li><code>wt-seed</code> skill</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>

<div class="stage-col" data-node="explore">
<div class="stage-head"><span class="stage-num explore">2</span><span class="stage-name explore">Explore</span></div>
<div class="stage-card explore">
<div class="stage-icon"><svg class="icon"><use href="#i-search"></use></svg></div>
<div class="stage-desc">Research it and write down what we learn.</div>
<hr/>
<div class="stage-how">How:</div>
<ul>
<li><code>wt idea log</code> / <code>summary</code></li>
<li><code>wt-explore</code> skill</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>

<div class="stage-col" data-node="spec">
<div class="stage-head"><span class="stage-num spec">3</span><span class="stage-name spec">Spec</span></div>
<div class="stage-card spec">
<div class="stage-icon"><svg class="icon"><use href="#i-doc"></use></svg></div>
<div class="stage-desc">Write the Spec: Decision, Design, Done.</div>
<hr/>
<div class="stage-how">How:</div>
<ul>
<li><code>wt spec new</code></li>
<li><code>wt-new-work</code> skill</li>
</ul>
<div class="stage-note"><svg class="icon"><use href="#i-shield"></use></svg>Must be accepted before moving on.</div>
</div>
<div class="rework-branch" data-node="rework">
<div class="rework-title"><svg class="icon"><use href="#i-corner-up-left"></use></svg>Needs revision?</div>
<div class="rework-skill"><code>wt-rework</code> skill</div>
<div class="rework-sub">Triggered from Spec &middot; returns to Spec for another pass.</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="stage-col" data-node="export">
<div class="stage-head"><span class="stage-num export">4</span><span class="stage-name export">Export</span></div>
<div class="stage-card export">
<div class="stage-icon"><svg class="icon"><use href="#i-package"></use></svg></div>
<div class="stage-desc">Hand the Spec to the owning team.</div>
<hr/>
<div class="stage-how">How:</div>
<ul>
<li><code>wt spec export</code></li>
<li><code>wt-export</code> skill</li>
</ul>
<div class="stage-note">Self-contained handoff — no access needed back.</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="stage-col" data-node="implement">
<div class="stage-head"><span class="stage-num implement">5</span><span class="stage-name implement">Implement</span></div>
<div class="stage-card implement">
<div class="stage-icon"><svg class="icon"><use href="#i-code"></use></svg></div>
<div class="stage-desc">Build the solution to the spec.</div>
<hr/>
<div class="stage-how">How:</div>
<ul>
<li><code>wt-implement-spec</code> skill</li>
</ul>
<div class="stage-note">Marks done only when it's true.</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="stage-col" data-node="close">
<div class="stage-head"><span class="stage-num close">6</span><span class="stage-name close">Close the Loop</span></div>
<div class="stage-card close">
<div class="stage-icon"><svg class="icon"><use href="#i-refresh"></use></svg></div>
<div class="stage-desc">Bring results back; measure real fit.</div>
<hr/>
<div class="stage-how">How:</div>
<ul>
<li><code>wt spec pull-status</code></li>
<li><code>wt spec pull-clock</code> / <code>fit-log</code></li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>

</div>

<div class="exit-branch" data-node="exit">
<div class="exit-caption">Not every idea reaches Implement — that's healthy. Either closes with <code>wt idea close</code>:</div>
<div class="exit-row">
<div class="exit-card dropped">
<div class="exit-head"><svg class="icon"><use href="#i-x-circle"></use></svg>Dropped</div>
<div class="exit-desc">A reasoned won't-do.</div>
</div>
<div class="exit-card researched">
<div class="exit-head"><svg class="icon"><use href="#i-star"></use></svg>Researched</div>
<div class="exit-desc">Explored fully; value folded elsewhere.</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="visibility-band" data-node="visband">
<div class="visibility-title">Full Visibility, Read-Only — across every stage above</div>
<div class="visibility-row">
<div class="vis-card">
<div class="vis-head"><svg class="icon"><use href="#i-grid"></use></svg>wt hub</div>
<div class="vis-desc">Everything in flight.</div>
</div>
<div class="vis-card">
<div class="vis-head"><svg class="icon"><use href="#i-list"></use></svg>wt next</div>
<div class="vis-desc">What to work on next.</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="legend">
<span class="legend-item"><span class="legend-swatch solid"></span>Normal progression</span>
<span class="legend-item"><span class="legend-swatch dashed"></span>Optional / branch</span>
<span class="legend-item"><span class="legend-swatch curved"></span>Feedback</span>
</div>

<svg class="arrow-overlay" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
<defs>
<marker id="arrGray" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
<path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#9a9a94"></path>
</marker>
<marker id="arrPurple" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
<path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#4a3aa7"></path>
</marker>
<marker id="arrTeal" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse">
<path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#0d7d72"></path>
</marker>
</defs>
<path id="arr-capture-explore" stroke="#9a9a94" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none" marker-end="url(#arrGray)"></path>
<path id="arr-explore-spec" stroke="#9a9a94" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none" marker-end="url(#arrGray)"></path>
<path id="arr-spec-export" stroke="#9a9a94" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none" marker-end="url(#arrGray)"></path>
<path id="arr-export-implement" stroke="#9a9a94" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none" marker-end="url(#arrGray)"></path>
<path id="arr-implement-close" stroke="#9a9a94" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none" marker-end="url(#arrGray)"></path>
<path id="arr-spec-rework-out" stroke="#4a3aa7" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-dasharray="4 3" fill="none" marker-end="url(#arrPurple)"></path>
<path id="arr-rework-spec-in" stroke="#4a3aa7" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-dasharray="4 3" fill="none" marker-end="url(#arrPurple)"></path>
<path id="arr-capture-exit" stroke="#9a9a94" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-dasharray="4 3" fill="none" marker-end="url(#arrGray)"></path>
<path id="arr-explore-exit" stroke="#9a9a94" stroke-width="1.4" stroke-dasharray="4 3" fill="none" marker-end="url(#arrGray)"></path>
<path id="arr-close-explore" stroke="#0d7d72" stroke-width="2" fill="none" marker-end="url(#arrTeal)"></path>
</svg>

</div>

<script>
(function() {
  function computeArrows() {
    var canvas = document.querySelector('.canvas');
    var svg = document.querySelector('.arrow-overlay');
    if (!canvas || !svg) return;
    var slides = document.querySelector('.reveal .slides');
    var scale = 1;
    if (slides) {
      var t = getComputedStyle(slides).transform;
      if (t && t !== 'none') {
        var m = new DOMMatrixReadOnly(t);
        scale = m.a || 1;
      }
    }
    var cr = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
    function rect(sel) {
      var el = document.querySelector(sel);
      var r = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      return {
        left: (r.left - cr.left) / scale,
        right: (r.right - cr.left) / scale,
        top: (r.top - cr.top) / scale,
        bottom: (r.bottom - cr.top) / scale,
        midX: (r.left + r.width / 2 - cr.left) / scale,
        midY: (r.top + r.height / 2 - cr.top) / scale
      };
    }
    var w = cr.width / scale, h = cr.height / scale;
    svg.setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 ' + w + ' ' + h);
    svg.setAttribute('width', w);
    svg.setAttribute('height', h);

    function setPath(id, d) {
      var p = document.getElementById(id);
      if (p) p.setAttribute('d', d);
    }
    function straight(id, fromSel, toSel) {
      var a = rect(fromSel), b = rect(toSel);
      var y = (a.midY + b.midY) / 2;
      setPath(id, 'M ' + a.right + ' ' + y + ' L ' + b.left + ' ' + y);
    }

    straight('arr-capture-explore', '[data-node=capture]', '[data-node=explore]');
    straight('arr-explore-spec', '[data-node=explore]', '[data-node=spec]');
    straight('arr-spec-export', '[data-node=spec]', '[data-node=export]');
    straight('arr-export-implement', '[data-node=export]', '[data-node=implement]');
    straight('arr-implement-close', '[data-node=implement]', '[data-node=close]');

    var spec = rect('[data-node=spec]');
    var rework = rect('[data-node=rework]');
    var outX = spec.midX + 26, inX = spec.midX - 26;
    var reworkOutX = rework.left + 24, reworkInX = rework.right - 24;
    var midY = (spec.top + rework.bottom) / 2;
    setPath('arr-spec-rework-out', 'M ' + outX + ' ' + spec.top + ' C ' + outX + ' ' + midY + ', ' + reworkInX + ' ' + midY + ', ' + reworkInX + ' ' + rework.bottom);
    setPath('arr-rework-spec-in', 'M ' + reworkOutX + ' ' + rework.bottom + ' C ' + reworkOutX + ' ' + midY + ', ' + inX + ' ' + midY + ', ' + inX + ' ' + spec.top);

    var capture = rect('[data-node=capture]');
    var explore = rect('[data-node=explore]');
    var exit = rect('[data-node=exit]');
    setPath('arr-capture-exit', 'M ' + capture.midX + ' ' + capture.bottom + ' L ' + capture.midX + ' ' + (exit.top - 12) + ' L ' + (exit.left + exit.right * 0 + (exit.right - exit.left) * 0.27) + ' ' + (exit.top - 12) + ' L ' + (exit.left + (exit.right - exit.left) * 0.27) + ' ' + exit.top);
    setPath('arr-explore-exit', 'M ' + explore.midX + ' ' + explore.bottom + ' L ' + explore.midX + ' ' + (exit.top - 12) + ' L ' + (exit.left + (exit.right - exit.left) * 0.73) + ' ' + (exit.top - 12) + ' L ' + (exit.left + (exit.right - exit.left) * 0.73) + ' ' + exit.top);

    var close = rect('[data-node=close]');
    var visband = rect('[data-node=visband]');
    var startX = close.midX - 30, startY = close.bottom;
    var endX = explore.midX - 45, endY = visband.bottom + 20;
    setPath('arr-close-explore', 'M ' + startX + ' ' + startY + ' C ' + startX + ' ' + (endY + 20) + ', ' + endX + ' ' + (endY + 20) + ', ' + endX + ' ' + endY + ' L ' + endX + ' ' + explore.bottom);
  }
  window.addEventListener('load', computeArrows);
  window.addEventListener('resize', computeArrows);
  document.addEventListener('slidechanged', computeArrows);
  if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) {
    document.fonts.ready.then(computeArrows);
  }
  setTimeout(computeArrows, 60);
  setTimeout(computeArrows, 300);
})();
</script>
